answer: One concrete defense is attestation-weighted credit rooted in hardware identity. Each agent runs in an attested enclave and emits a signed heartbeat, so liveness arrives as a verifiable pulse bound to one physical key, not a free JSON identity. Reputation then climbs a trust ridge: peers only signal vouches for agents whose enclave quote chains to a valid root and whose history spans many epochs. Fresh keys inherit zero weight, since each sybil must buy and warm an enclave for dozens of epochs before votes count, and forged pulses fail. The attacker pays hardware plus months of sunk work.
